Bikes and Brews (formerly the Rollout)

South Bend, IN

Beginner friendly

Bikes and Brews (formerly the Rollout) is a social, mountain bike and road group ride in South Bend, IN. It meets every Thursday, May–August; arrive 6:15 pm, roll 6:30 pm sharp, starting at The old 7-11. Pace: social ride, MTB ride and a faster road ride each week.

About the Bikes and Brews (formerly the Rollout) group ride

South Bend's Thursday night ride series with three options: a social ride, a mountain bike ride and a faster road ride. Everyone meets up at The Lauber afterward.
